facts.fact: The Ranu graves lie in rows on the terraced slope above the village, cut into frozen ground; the smaller mounds are child-length and some carry toys or pine boughs.
facts.why: needed because the beat requires Rohan to count new graves on the slope.

facts.fact: Rohan counts thirty-one new graves; Nimmi says thirty-one died this winter, before midwinter.
facts.why: needed because the outline fixes the figure at thirty-one.

facts.fact: Meera and Rohan leave the Rope-Hut by the winter line down the south slope to the Neshar road at the third bend, because the Goat's Teeth chimney is plugged by the slab.
facts.why: needed to move them from the hut to Ranu after ch15-16.

facts.fact: Meera now calls Rohan by name when she wants to be heard, and tells him to walk behind her and uphill of her so he can anchor the rope.
facts.why: needed to show the promise being kept by deferring to her.

facts.fact: Rohan splits his right knuckles on the herdsmen's stone fold in anger over Varun.
facts.why: needed because the beat has him let anger show over Varun.
